data.name: Enable Earth
data.description: Enable Earth is a biochar project developer based in Wiang Pa Pao District, Chiang Rai Province, Thailand. It converts corn crop residues — otherwise openly burned and contributing to PM2.5 pollution — into biochar via pyrolysis, mixes it with compost, and distributes it to local farmers. The project has passed Puro.earth's Preliminary Assessment and is listed as a future supplier.
